<title level="1" right="Class Feature 1">[Hunt Prey](/Classes.aspx?ID=9)</title>

<column gap="tiny">
**Source** [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 166

**Class** Ranger
</column>

---

When you focus your attention on a single foe, you become unstoppable in your pursuit. You gain the Hunt Prey action.
